declarations.name: AuiPasswordInput
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI PasswordInput: `<aui-password-input>`.
Implements ControlValueAccessor and Validator (error key `aui`); `[(value)]` without forms.

inputs.name: autocomplete
inputs.description: Password-manager hint. Use new-password on sign-up and change-password forms.

inputs.name: describedBy
inputs.description: Extra element ids for aria-describedby (e.g. a strength meter).

inputs.name: validate
inputs.description: Consumer validation; the message must not contain the value.

inputs.name: validationTiming
inputs.description: When validation messages first appear; afterwards they update live.

inputs.name: capsLockWarning
inputs.description: Show a warning while Caps Lock is on and the field has focus.

models.name: value
models.description: The value: `[(value)]` without forms; with Angular forms, bind the form control instead.

outputs.name: valueInput
outputs.description: User edited the value (the value is not in the detail).

outputs.name: capsLockChange
outputs.description: The Caps Lock warning appeared or disappeared.

properties.name: formState
properties.description: Angular form state of this control.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now (marks the control submitted) and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error (server, cross-field rule); null clears it.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Move focus to the primary focusable element.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value and clear dirty/touched/submitted state.

accessibility.pattern: Native password <input> with <label for>, plus a toggle button (aria-pressed).

limitations: Caps Lock state is known only after a key or mouse event in the field (browsers expose it through getModifierState).
Revealing shows the password on screen: shoulder surfing is the user's decision.
Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
